name: liner
description: Liner elements support a flexible host surface (tunnel lining, sprayed concrete, etc.) with bidirectional coupling springs to the host zones. Property keyword set is binary-validated against FLAC2D 9.0 ('structure liner property ?').

notes: FLAC2D liners use bending/section properties similar to beams. 'thickness' (common to FLAC3D shells) is NOT a FLAC2D liner property — use cross-sectional-area and moi instead.
'thermal-expansion' is NOT a liner property in FLAC2D 9.0.
These keywords drive the coupling on the default (side-1) face.
The '-2' suffixed keywords configure the SECOND side of a double-sided liner.
Activate side-2 coupling per liner with the 'effective' property keyword on the relevant create / property command.

verification: Live FLAC2D 9 re-check (2026-08-13): 'structure liner property' enumerates the full documented 2D set (section props incl. spacing + all 12 coupling-*/-2 keywords + slide/slide-tolerance); 'thickness' and 'thermal-expansion' confirmed absent. shell/geogrid/dowel/hybrid rejections reproduced verbatim. 2D liner also exposes 'cmodel' with the 5 beam-family models — see structure-cmodels.json.

examples.command:
structure liner create by-line (0,0) (1,0)
structure liner property young 2e10 poisson 0.2 cross-sectional-area 0.25 moi 1.3e-3 coupling-stiffness-normal 1e9 coupling-stiffness-shear 1e9 coupling-cohesion-shear 1e5 coupling-friction-shear 30
structure liner property coupling-stiffness-normal 1e9 coupling-stiffness-shear 1e9 coupling-stiffness-normal-2 1e9 coupling-stiffness-shear-2 1e9

notes: FLAC3D-only structure types: shell, geogrid, dowel, hybrid.

FLAC2D 9.0 does NOT accept 'structure shell', 'structure geogrid', 'structure dowel', or 'structure hybrid' subcommands — these are 3D-only structural element types ('Bad conversion of parameter number 2').
Use FLAC3D documentation for these element-type property keyword sets.

FLAC3D liner uses a DIFFERENT property keyword set than FLAC2D liner. FLAC3D models liners as a shell-formulation surface (area-based) while FLAC2D models them as a beam-formulation line (length-based).

The FLAC3D liner property set: density, range, thermal-expansion, thickness, effective, slide, slide-tolerance, and all 12 coupling-* / coupling-*-2 keywords (binary-verified via 'structure liner property ?').
The FLAC2D liner property set (documented in this file's property_groups) shares only the coupling-* and slide-* keywords with FLAC3D.
FLAC3D shell property keyword set (binary-verified via 'structure shell property ?'). Shells are FLAC3D-only.

FLAC3D shells take only the basic surface-element properties WITHOUT a cmodel assigned; assigning a shell constitutive model ('structure shell cmodel assign <model>', 7 models available) EXPANDS the property keyword set with that model's material properties (e.g. elastic adds young + poisson). The same mechanism applies to liner and geogrid. See structure-cmodels.json for the per-model property sets and the elastic->plastic assignment trap. Live-verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

The FLAC3D liner and geogrid base property sets in this file were re-verified against live FLAC3D 9.7 error enumeration (exact match, including the 12 coupling-*/-2 liner keywords and geogrid's shear-only bare coupling-* names).
FLAC3D geogrid property keyword set (binary-verified via 'structure geogrid property ?'). Geogrids are FLAC3D-only.
Geogrids use SHEAR-only coupling (no normal direction): the bare 'coupling-cohesion / -friction / -stiffness' keywords without the '-shear' suffix.
